text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes. The showdown with the Mejiro family,
the Hanshin JF!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What difference does family background make?
It's even! Yes, everyone is on even ground!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
An insurmountable difference in environment.
Such a thing...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if God forgives you, I won't!
Come on, let's go, Trainer!
Spinning around on her heel, Seeking the Pearl heads toward the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're here, Pearl-san.
I look forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I will deliver a run superior to Pearl-san's.
As a representative of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, you stepped up carrying your own bonds.
Dober. But—”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I have a bond that won't lose to yours, either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even Pearl-san has... bonds? I never
really pictured that kind of thing with her, though.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, because right now it's still a fragile bond. But—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Eventually, it'll grow stronger! And from here on out, it will spread wider and wider!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"My bond is...
with some unknown somebody, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Some stranger...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, the bonds we form are not limited
solely to family. Even if the bonds we are born with
are unyielding—”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You can form bonds with others, too!
And make them even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I'll prove it to you.
By running evenly or better than you in this race."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's quite grand. Yes, very grand...
I don't know any other Umamusume who thinks like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's precisely why I want to surpass you.
In this race that marks the end of our Junior Class!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Come on, Dober♪
Come on! Come on, girl!!

Family isn't defined only by blood. With that ideal in her heart,
Seeking the Pearl heads into the Hanshin JF.
